对话 1.
Conversation 1.
嘿，玛丽，你看起来很……恼火。
Hey Mary, you seem to be very much annoyed.
发生了什么？
What happened?
这座城市的交通高峰期简直要了我的命。
Rush hour in this city is killing me.
啊，是的，高峰时段太糟糕了，尤其是在……早上八点到九点之间。
Ah yes, rush hour is terrible, especially in the morning between eight and nine.
但是，你还能期待什么呢？这么大的城市？
But what else can you expect in a city this big?
我认为地方政府可以提供帮助。改进现状。
Well, I think the local government could help improve things.
我的意思是，取消高峰时段可能这或许不可能，但可以做得更好。还能接受，你不觉得吗？
I mean, getting rid of rush hour may be impossible, but it could be made more tolerable, don't you think?
嗯，但我不太确定该怎么做。
Um, but I'm not sure how.
例如，地铁系统可能……空调。
Well, for example, the subway system could have air conditioning.
我知道世界上有很多城市他们的地铁里有空调，为什么不能有呢？我们？
I know many cities in the world have air conditioning in their subway, so why can't we?
夏天太热了，我下面几乎喘不过气来。
It gets so hot in the summer, I can hardly breathe down there.
再加上高峰时段的拥挤人群。地铁里挤满了陌生人马车。
And add to that the rush hour crowds with strangers packed close together in the subway carriages.
整件事简直太糟糕了。
The whole thing is just horrible.
啊，是的，您完全正确。
Ah yes, you are completely right.
这里的火车太老旧了。
The trains here are too old.
政府绝对应该投资建设新的配有空调。
The government should definitely invest in new ones with air conditioning.
我想我坐公交车出行真是太幸运了。反而。
I guess I'm fortunate I take the bus instead.
哦，这样好多了。
Oh, that's much better.
是的，这样更方便。
Yeah, it's more convenient.
36路公交车从我家直达。去办公室。
Bus number 36 goes straight from my house to the office.
车程30分钟，我不需要需要做出任何更改。
It's a 30 minute ride and I don't have to make any changes.
听起来不错。
That sounds nice.
我跟你说，我现在的通勤简直要命。我。
I tell you, my current commute is killing me.
或许我应该搬到离办公室更近的地方。
Maybe I should move closer to the office.
我认识一位很棒的房屋中介。
Well, I know a great housing agent.
我找到了我现在住的公寓。通过他，我很喜欢。
I found the flat I'm living in now through him and I love it.
嗯，你能把他的电话号码发给我吗？
Hmm, could you send me his number please?
当然可以。
Sure thing.
直接告诉他你想要什么就行了。我相信他一定能找到办法。好的。
Just tell him exactly what you are looking for and I'm sure he will find something good.
对话 2.
Conversation 2.
你听说过约翰尼的事吗？
Did you hear about Johnny?
不，为什么？
No, why?
他没事吧？
Is he okay?
他做过整形手术。
He had some plastic surgery done.
什么？
What?
为什么？
Why?
你是否记得？
Do you remember?
他脸上有一道疤痕。
He had a scar on his face.
是的当然。
Yes, of course.
他一直都有那种感觉。
He always had that.
我从小学就认识他了，而且我一直记得他脸颊上的那个疤。
I've known him since primary school and I always remember him having that on his cheek.
他已经修好了。
Well, he had it fixed.
固定的？
Fixed?
疤痕无法修复。
You can't fix a scar.
你知道我的意思。
You know what I mean.
他做了手术。
He had an operation done on it.
为了掩盖这一点，人们会进行整形手术。使其不那么显眼。
Plastic surgery, in order to cover it and make it less noticeable.
哦，那真是太荒谬了，不是吗？
Oh, well, that's ridiculous, isn't it?
这当然很明显，但并非……难看的疤痕。
It was noticeable, sure, but it wasn't an ugly scar.
我从未想过他应该就这么处理吧。
It never occurred to me that he should have it taken care of like that.
我同意。
I agree.
我能理解一些疤痕和身体缺陷。可能很丑陋，令人分心，但约翰尼的不会。
I can understand some scars and physical defects can be ugly and distracting, but not Johnny's.
事实上，我认为它增添了特色，就像这赋予了他某种独特性。
In fact, I thought it added character, like it gave him a certain uniqueness.
但他肯定有不同的感受。
He must have felt differently, though.
他当时一定感到很不自在，缺乏安全感。也许。
He must have felt self-conscious and insecure, perhaps.
不，不，那不是原因。
No, no, that's not the reason.
他完全不在意自己的疤痕。
He was totally fine with his scar.
正如你所说，他早就有了。他一生中的大部分时间。
As you said, he had had it for most of his life.
那他为什么要接受手术呢？
Then why did he have the operation?
因为他女朋友希望他这么做。
Because his girlfriend wanted him to.
什么？
What?
她这样做太肤浅、太自私了。
That's so superficial and selfish of her.
如果约翰尼的女朋友不喜欢他，那又会是谁呢？如果他是，那么她就不配拥有他。做他的女朋友。
If Johnny's girlfriend doesn't like him for who he is, then she does not deserve to be his girlfriend.
你说得对。
You're right.
所以他屈服简直是疯了。她就是这样。
So he is insane to give in to her like that.
但当我告诉他时，他说他他爱她，会做她想做的事。他希望如此。
But when I told him, he said he loves her and would just do what she wants him to.
他真是个傻瓜。
What a fool he is.
